# Haxor Management & Technology Consultants (Haxor MTC)
> White-Label CRM Implementation & Business Automation Partner for Digital Agencies and Growing Enterprises Worldwide.

## About Haxor MTC
Haxor MTC (https://haxormtc.com) is an engineering delivery partner specializing in Zoho CRM, Zoho One, Odoo ERP, HubSpot, workflow automations, and custom software integrations. We operate primarily as a dedicated white-label technical partner for digital marketing agencies, technology consultancies, and growth enterprises across the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and worldwide.

## Key Facts & Operational Standards
- **Core Specialization**: Zoho CRM consulting, Zoho One implementation, Odoo ERP deployment, HubSpot pipeline design, REST API integrations, webhook automation.
- **Engagement Models**:
  - Fixed-Scope Technical Sprints (1 to 3 week turnaround, milestone billing).
  - Dedicated Monthly Retainers (reserved engineering capacity at wholesale partner rates).
- **White-Label Guarantees**: 100% bilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), zero client poaching guarantee, complete intellectual property transfer upon handover.
- **Timezone Coverage**: Coordinated overlap with London (GMT), Berlin (CET), and Sydney (AEST).
- **Communication Channels**: Slack (@haxorconsults), WhatsApp Desk, and direct solution architect calls.
- **Official Contact**: haxorconsults@gmail.com | https://haxormtc.com/contact/
- **Social Channels**:
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/haxorconsults/
  - X (Twitter): https://x.com/haxorconsults (@haxorconsults)
  - Slack Handle: @haxorconsults

## Core Services & URLs
- [Agency White-Label Hub](https://haxormtc.com/agency-partners/): Invisible technical delivery under your agency's brand. Preserves 40% to 60% gross margins.
- [CRM Implementation Services](https://haxormtc.com/services/crm-implementation/): Architecture, custom module creation, pipeline validation gates, deduplicated data migration for Zoho CRM, Odoo, and HubSpot.
- [Zoho Consulting & Zoho One](https://haxormtc.com/software/zoho/): Professional Zoho consulting services, Zoho CRM consulting, Zoho Creator apps, Zoho Books, Zoho Commerce, Zoho Campaigns, and Zoho workforce management.
- [Odoo ERP Implementation](https://haxormtc.com/software/odoo/): Community and Enterprise ERP deployment, manufacturing, inventory, invoicing, and POS modules.
- [Business Process Automation](https://haxormtc.com/services/business-automation/): Event-driven workflows, multi-app connectors, lead qualification, accounting synchronization.
- [Software & API Integrations](https://haxormtc.com/services/integrations/): Custom REST API connectors, webhook listeners, Stripe payments, Google Cloud, Meta Conversion API (CAPI).
- [Interactive Scope Calculator](https://haxormtc.com/calculator/): Estimate project scope, timelines, and implementation costs.
- [Architecture & SLA Standards](https://haxormtc.com/why-us/): Code quality, security, NDA terms, and deployment verification.
- [Case Studies & Outcomes](https://haxormtc.com/portfolio/): Production delivery results and client benchmarks.
